description: Render any web page URL to PDF with full JavaScript execution — custom viewport width, lazy content loading, wait delay. Returns PDF download URL (ConvertAPI)

delay.description: Seconds to wait after page load before capturing (default 0)

load_lazy_content.description: Scroll page to trigger lazy-loaded images (default false)

url.description: Web page URL to render as PDF (e.g. "https://example.com")

name: document.convert.web_to_pdf

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Web Page to PDF (ConvertAPI)
